name: std::flat_map<Key,T,Compare,KeyContainer,MappedContainer>::insert_range

declarations.code:
template <container - compatible - range<value_type> R>

void insert_range(R &&rg);

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
rg

 -

 a container compatible range, that is, an input_range whose elements are convertible to T

sections.title: Complexity
sections.text: N + M·log(M), where N is size() before the operation and M is ranges::distance(rg).

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: Since insert_range performs an in-place merge operation, that may allocate memory.

summary: Inserts a copy of each element in the range rg into underlying containers c as if by:
